causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall exhaust hood operates correctly and is clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Controls improperly set"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
Since most dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Underloading"

symptoms.symptom: The DRY dryness level was chosen but load is still damp

causes.label: Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics
remedies: When combining heavy and light fabrics in a load, choose MORE DRY.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics"

causes.label: Exhaust system is blocked
remedies: Inspect and clean exhaust system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Exhaust system is blocked"

causes.label: Controls accidentally put in service mode
remedies: Press START/PAUSE.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Controls accidentally put in service mode"

causes.label: Controls accidentally put in lock mode
remedies: Hold the LOCK button for 3 seconds to unlock the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Controls accidentally put in lock mode"

causes.label: Controls performed an incorrect operation
remedies: Reset the in-house breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Controls performed an incorrect operation"

causes.label: Control panel is “asleep”
remedies: This is normal.
Press POWER to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Control panel is “asleep”"

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Electric dryers use two fuses or breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Start
remedies: If the light on the START/PAUSE button is flashing, the dryer is paused.
Press START/PAUSE to restart the countdown.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 32: "Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Start"

symptoms.symptom: No numbers displayed during cycle, only lights

causes.label: Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes
remedies: This is normal.
When the dryer senses a low level of moisture in the load, the dryer will display the dry time remaining.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes"

symptoms.symptom: Time Remaining jumped to a lower number

causes.label: The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot make a selection and the dryer beeps twice

causes.label: The DRYNESS LEVEL, TEMP or OPTION that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "The DRYNESS LEVEL, TEMP or OPTION that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer is running but 00 is displayed in Time Remaining

causes.label: The EXTEND TUMBLE option was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
During extended tumbling, the time remaining is not displayed.
The extended tumbling option lasts approximately 20 minutes.
It will then tumble intermittently for approximately 70 minutes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "The EXTEND TUMBLE option was chosen"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Drying time will vary according to the type of heat used.
If you recently changed from an electric to a gas (natural or LP) dryer, or vice versa, the drying time could be different.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Type of heat"

causes.label: Type of load and drying conditions
remedies: The load size, types of fabric, wetness of clothes and the length and condition of the exhaust system will affect drying times.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Type of load and drying conditions"

symptoms.symptom: Glow at the rear of the drum

causes.label: Heaters behind the drum
remedies: This is normal.
Under certain drying conditions and room ambient lighting, the glow of the heaters may be visible at the rear of the drum.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Heaters behind the drum"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a LESS DRY or DAMP setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately, or use the EXTEND TUMBLE option.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Overloading"

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Clothes were not completely clean"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under STATIC.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Overloading"

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust setting to LESS DRY or DAMP.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

symptoms.symptom: Collars and waistbands still wet at end of cycle

causes.label: The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry
remedies: Choose SPEED DRY or TIMED DRY to dry damp collars and waistbands.
In the future, when drying a load with collars and waistbands, choose MORE DRY.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Due to the metallic properties of paint used for this unique product, slight variations of color may occur due to viewing angles and lighting conditions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "This is normal"
